BEGIN INSERT INTO FUNDINFO (FUNDID, FUNDNM, CURRENCYTYPE, FUNDST, TANO, DISPLAYORDER, INSERTTIMESTAMP, UPDATETIMESTAMP, NAVDT, NAV) VALUES( #{fundId}, #{fundNm}, #{currencyType}, #{fundSt}, #{taNo}, (SELECT MAX(DISPLAYORDER)+1 FROM FUNDINFO), SYSDATE, SYSDATE, #{navDate}, #{nav} );
INSERT INTO FUNDINFOEX (FUNDID, FUNDCHINESENM, FUNDENGLISHNM, INVESTTYPE, FUNDTP, FUNDRISKLEVEL, ISSUEPRICE, FACEVALUE, MANAGERNAME, TRUSTEENAME, TANM, ISSUEDATE, SETUPDATE, MANAGERRATIO, NAVFRACNUM, NAVFRACMODE, MINSUBAMT, MINBIDAMT, MINREDAMT, MINCONVAMT, MINRSPAMT, INSERTTIMESTAMP, UPDATETIMESTAMP, TRANSFERDAYS, FUNDEVALDATE, MELONDAYS, SUBDAYS, CYCLETP, CYCLELEN, FUNDDISPTP, PARENTFUNDID) VALUES( #{fundId}, #{fundNm}, #{fundEnglishNm}, #{investType}, #{fundType}, #{fundRiskLevel}, #{issuePrice}, #{fundDenomina}, #{managerNm}, #{trusteeNm}, #{taNm}, #{issueDate}, #{setUpDate}, #{managerRates}, #{navFracNum}, #{navFracMode}, #{minSubAmt}, #{minBidAmt}, #{minRedAmt}, #{minConvAmt}, #{minRspAmt}, SYSDATE, SYSDATE, #{redeemToAcctDays}, #{fundEvalDate}, #{redMelonDays}, #{subDays}, #{cycletp}, #{cyclelen}, #{fundDispType}, #{parentFundid}); END;

mapper.select: SELECT T1.FUNDID, T2.FUNDCHINESENM, T1.CURRENCYTYPE, T1.NAV, T2.MINSUBAMT, T2.MINBIDAMT, T2.MINREDAMT, T2.MINCONVAMT, T2.MINRSPAMT, T2.INDIMAXPURCHASE, T1.TANO, T2.FUNDTP, T2.FUNDDISPTP, T2.FUNDRISKLEVEL, T2.FUNDEVALDATE, T1.FUNDST, T2.NAVFRACNUM, T2.NAVFRACMODE, T2.CYCLETP, T2.CYCLELEN, T2.TRUSTEENAME, T2.ISSUEPRICE, T2.ISSUEDATE, T2.SETUPDATE, --ADDED BY ZENGXY 20130902 托管人名称 发行价格 募集开始、结束日 CASE WHEN T1.TANO = '98' THEN (SELECT KYDATE FROM SYSALTER S WHERE S.KEY3 = 'LASTDATE') WHEN T1.TANO = '17' THEN (SELECT T1.NAVDT FROM FUNDINFO T3 WHERE T3.FUNDID = T2.FUNDID) END AS NAVDT FROM FUNDINFO T1, FUNDINFOEX T2 WHERE T2.FUNDID = T1.FUNDID AND T1.FUNDID NOT IN (SELECT PMCO FROM PARAMETER WHERE PMST = 'SYSTEM' AND PMKY = 'UNFUNDID') ORDER BY T1.DISPLAYORDER ASC
SELECT F.FUNDID, F.FUNDNM, F.NAV, F.NAVDT FROM FUNDINFO F, FUNDINFOEX FF WHERE F.FUNDID = FF.FUNDID AND FF.FUNDDISPTP = '9'

SELECT T.FUNDID FUNDID, T.FUNDNM FUNDNM, T.CURRENCYTYPE CURRENCYTYPE, (SELECT PMNM FROM PARAMETER T WHERE T.PMST = 'SYSTEM' AND T.PMKY = 'CURRENCYTYPE' AND T.PMCO = T.CURRENCYTYPE) CURRENCYTYPENM, T.FUNDST FUNDST, (SELECT PMNM FROM PARAMETER T WHERE T.PMST = 'SYSTEM' AND T.PMKY = 'FUNDST' AND T.PMCO = T.FUNDST) FUNDSTNM, T.TANO TANO, T.NAV NAV, TO_CHAR(T.UPDATETIMESTAMP,'YYYY-MM-DD hh24:mi:ss') UPDATETIMESTAMP, T.DISPLAYORDER DISPLAYORDER, T2.ISSUEPRICE ISSUEPRICE, T2.FUNDTP FUNDTP, (SELECT PMNM FROM PARAMETER T WHERE T.PMST = 'SYSTEM' AND T.PMKY = 'FUNDTP' AND T.PMCO = T2.FUNDTP) FUNDTPNM, T2.FUNDRISKLEVEL FUNDRISKLEVEL, T2.FUNDEVALDATE FUNDEVALDATE, T2.FUNDDISPTP FUNDDISPTP FROM FUNDINFO T, FUNDINFOEX T2 WHERE T.FUNDID = T2.FUNDID
AND T.FUNDID LIKE '%' || #{sp.fundid} || '%'
AND T.FUNDNM LIKE '%' || #{sp.fundname} || '%'
ORDER BY DISPLAYORDER ASC

SELECT T.FUNDID, T.FUNDNM, T.CURRENCYTYPE, T.FUNDST, T.TANO, T.DISPLAYORDER, T.INSERTTIMESTAMP, T.UPDATETIMESTAMP, T.NAVDT, T.NAV, T2.FUNDCHINESENM, T2.FUNDENGLISHNM, T2.INVESTTYPE, T2.FUNDTP, T2.ISSUEPRICE, T2.FACEVALUE, T2.MANAGERNAME, T2.TRUSTEENAME, T2.TANM,
TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(T2.ISSUEDATE,'YYYY-MM-DD'),'YYYY-MM-DD') ISSUEDATE, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(T2.SETUPDATE,'YYYY-MM-DD'),'YYYY-MM-DD') SETUPDATE, T2.MANAGERRATIO, T2.MINSUBAMT, T2.MINBIDAMT, T2.MINREDAMT, T2.MINCONVAMT, T2.MINRSPAMT, TRANSFERDAYS, FUNDRISKLEVEL, NAVFRACNUM, NAVFRACMODE, FUNDEVALDATE, MINCONVERTINBYINST, MELONDAYS, INDIMAXPURCHASE, CYCLETP, CYCLELEN, PARENTFUNDID, FUNDDISPTP, PARENTFUNDID, SUBDAYS, KEEPLIMIT, FUNDSIZE, ECMAXPURCHASE, NEXTISSUEDATE, FEATURE, PRODUCTTIMELIMIT, ISUNFUND FROM FUNDINFO_PRE T,FUNDINFOEX_PRE T2 WHERE T.FUNDID = T2.FUNDID AND T.FUNDID = #{fundId}

SELECT T.FUNDID, T.FUNDNM, T.CURRENCYTYPE, T.FUNDST, T.TANO, T.DISPLAYORDER, T.INSERTTIMESTAMP, T.UPDATETIMESTAMP, T.NAVDT, T.NAV, T2.FUNDCHINESENM, T2.FUNDENGLISHNM, T2.INVESTTYPE, T2.FUNDTP, T2.ISSUEPRICE, T2.FACEVALUE, T2.MANAGERNAME, T2.TRUSTEENAME, T2.TANM,

SELECT T.FUNDID FUNDID, T.FUNDNM FUNDNM, T.CURRENCYTYPE CURRENCYTYPE, (SELECT PMNM FROM PARAMETER T WHERE T.PMST = 'SYSTEM' AND T.PMKY = 'CURRENCYTYPE' AND T.PMCO = T.CURRENCYTYPE) CURRENCYTYPENM, T.FUNDST FUNDST, (SELECT PMNM FROM PARAMETER T WHERE T.PMST = 'SYSTEM' AND T.PMKY = 'FUNDST' AND T.PMCO = T.FUNDST) FUNDSTNM, T.TANO TANO, T.NAV NAV, TO_CHAR(T.UPDATETIMESTAMP,'YYYY-MM-DD hh24:mi:ss') UPDATETIMESTAMP, T.DISPLAYORDER DISPLAYORDER, T2.ISSUEPRICE ISSUEPRICE, T2.FUNDTP FUNDTP, (SELECT PMNM FROM PARAMETER T WHERE T.PMST = 'SYSTEM' AND T.PMKY = 'FUNDTP' AND T.PMCO = T2.FUNDTP) FUNDTPNM, T2.FUNDRISKLEVEL FUNDRISKLEVEL, T2.FUNDEVALDATE FUNDEVALDATE, T2.FUNDDISPTP FUNDDISPTP, PROCESSOR, CHECKTIMESTAMP, CHECKER, CHECKSTATUS FROM FUNDINFO_PRE T, FUNDINFOEX_PRE T2 WHERE T.FUNDID = T2.FUNDID AND T.CHECKSTATUS = 'I'
